{{Top|leg}}
'''Laser-flash signallers''' were visual communication systems used by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Ferret-class reconnaissance vessel|''Ferret''-class]] and [[Prowler-class reconnaissance vessel|''Prowler''-class reconnaissance vessels]]. Ferrets and Prowlers working together under communications blackout could use the unidirectional laser-flash signallers to communicate with each other effectively.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
